text_block_list.text:
“—Autumn. For an Umamusume who loves to 
eat, it is a rather tough season.”

text_block_list.name: Baker
text_block_list.text:
Fresh in season! Rich apple pies, fresh 
out of the oven~ Care for one~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hau... Apple pie...!
choice_data_list:
There are so many temptations around this 
time of year...

There sure are lots of temptations around 
this time of year...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've always loved apple pie, and 
besides...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In "The Blue Rose of Happiness," there's a 
scene where Dear Brother makes an apple 
pie...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In "The Blue Rose of Happiness," there's a 
scene where Dear Sister makes an apple 
pie...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"To make sure the blue rose wouldn't feel 
lonely, they made a rose apple pie for it. 
...And you know what? The rose was 
actually blue!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That story made me love it even more... So 
truthfully... I want to eat until I'm 
full, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But—I'll endure... it! It's the race 
season, so Rice... won't give up!

With a big race ahead, Rice Shower has 
been holding back on sweets lately.

Her training is going well, so I want to 
treat her to some food as a reward. A full 
belly might be tough, but—
choice_data_list:
(If I can satisfy her some other way 
instead!)

text_block_list.text:
Under the concept of 'satisfaction through 
means other than quantity', we made 
various preparations... and a few days 
later.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
――Big Brother, I changed into my outfit, 
but... How... does it look...?
choice_data_list: Perfect! It looks amazing on you!
Perfect! It looks amazing on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
――Big Sister, I changed into my outfit, 
but... How... does it look...?
choice_data_list: Perfect! It looks amazing on you!
Perfect! It looks amazing on you!

text_block_list.text:
She seemed to like the apron dress meant 
to set the mood. ...I wonder if she'll 
like my next "idea" too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother...! Fufufu, ehehe. 
Wearing this outfit makes me feel like a 
picture book character, it gets my heart 
pounding...♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister...! Fufufu, ehehe. 
Wearing this outfit makes me feel like a 
picture book character, it gets my heart 
pounding...♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Still, are you really sure? Rice is 
happy to make sweets, but...
choice_data_list: It's fine! We only have to make "this"!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
? Is this "The Blue Rose of Happiness"? 
Ah, the scene where Big Brother baked an 
apple pie—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
? Is this "The Blue Rose of Happiness"? 
Ah, the scene where Big Sister baked an 
apple pie—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAT!? What we're making is... this 
rose apple pie!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Big Brother, you're amazing! The 
apple turned blue, just like in the 
picture book...!
choice_data_list:
Thanks! ...The real problem is what comes 
next, though.

Thanks! ...The real issue is what's up 
next, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Big Sister, you're amazing! The 
apple turned blue, just like in the 
picture book...!
choice_data_list:
Thanks! ...The real problem is what comes 
next, though.

Thanks! ...The real issue is what's up 
next, right?

text_block_list.text:
Looking closely at the cute drawing after 
she said that, I see not a rose made of 
sliced apples... but a rose "bud".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It looks hard, so maybe flowers after 
all...? Rice would still be plenty happy 
with that, you know...?
choice_data_list: No, it absolutely has to be a "bud."

text_block_list.text:
"...In making this apple pie, re-reading 
the story made me realize. The importance 
of it being a rose 'bud.'"

text_block_list.name: Picture Book Dialogue
text_block_list.text:
"—I made this thinking of giving you a 
friend, but... the first blue rose I ever 
see... it has to be you."

text_block_list.name: Picture Book Dialogue
text_block_list.text:
"—I made this thinking of giving you a 
friend, but... the first blue rose I ever 
see... it has to be you, right?"

"Because this rose 'bud' is surely the 
very form of kindness that Rice Shower 
loves."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice will help too! Let's do our best 
together, Big Brother!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice will help too! Let's do our best 
together, Big Sister!"
And at last...

I carefully take the freshly baked apple 
pie out of the oven and place it right in 
front of Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —...Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That was incredible, Big 
Brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That was incredible, Big 
Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's the apple pie from "The Blue Rose of 
Happiness"! The one Dear Brother made for 
the blue rose...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's the apple pie from "The Blue Rose of 
Happiness"! The one Dear Sister made for 
the blue rose...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It feels like a dream...!

Seeing Rice Shower's sparkling eyes, I 
breathe a sigh of relief. For now, the 
plan is a success.
choice_data_list:
Shall we try eating it while it's still 
warm, then?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Chomp!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe♪ It's apple pie...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The apple flavor doesn't lose out to the 
custard at all! It's freshly baked, so the 
crust is nice and crispy, too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it has such a gentle, 
comforting flavor...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm super-duper-duper-duper 
satisfied...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me to make sweets, 
Dear Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me to make sweets, 
Dear Sister!
